cases.title: OEIS daily sequence corpus
cases.summary_claim: The prefix-recognized symbolic families fail to surpass the frozen flexible control in this source cohort.
cases.grouping: Canonical affine-normalized sixteen-term prefix family; semantic relationships not exhaustively known
cases.limits: Hash-selected finite-range OEIS reference challenge, not mathematical proof or new sequence discovery. Affine prefix aliases linked; other semantic dependence remains. Finite continuations never uniquely determine a law.

cases.title: MAST TARS TESS Sector 96 light curves and vetting images
cases.summary_claim: A compact causal response transfers across the two reserved stars within this corrected sector product.
cases.grouping: Star; repeated hourly bins are dependent
cases.limits: Eight selected stars in one TESS sector; no new planet, stellar period or universal rotation law. Missing per-cadence quality/error columns limit robustness.

cases.title: GWOSC O4a H1 strain and detector-quality masks
cases.summary_claim: The campaign does not establish a transferable nonstationary detector-noise law.
cases.grouping: Contiguous512-second block in one detector segment; blocks not independent experiments
cases.limits: Single4096-second H1 segment; this is detector-noise monitoring, not GW detection or source parameter inference. Conditional on supplied quality mask. The entire source has injectionmask23: a continuous-wave hardware injection is present. This study concerns recorded strain-band power including possible injected contribution, NOT uncontaminated detector noise or astrophysical inference. No-cbc/burst/detchar/stochastic injections required; CW status retained.

cases.title: ATLAS 2015 four-lepton open data across run periods

cases.grouping: Run period, with unique runNumber+eventNumber observations
cases.limits: 2015 four-lepton educational skim, no MC or control background supplied. Object recoil and MET share reconstruction components; predictive agreement is not independent discovery of momentum conservation or new physics.

cases.title: Dataset for "A Computational Search for Minimal Obstruction Graphs for the Lovász-Schrijver SDP Hierarchy"
cases.summary_claim: Accuracy alone is non-discriminating in this constant-target certificate collection.
cases.grouping: Source certificate implication family; author-certified graphs and linked edge subgraphs remain together
cases.limits: Finite selected source graphs, not theorem proving for arbitrary graphs or rediscovery of source LS+ ranks. Exact search comparator defines attainable error, so approximate bounds cannot claim superior accuracy.

cases.title: Multimodal gait EEG, EMG, and force-plate data for participant S1
cases.summary_claim: Causal previous-cycle force provides the strongest registered development-selected forecast and transfers to the faster held run
cases.grouping: Entire speed run within one participant; only two development runs and one faster reserved run
cases.limits: One participant, three treadmill speeds; no independent-person generalization. Force-platform channels are signed and the source timing columns are unusable.

cases.title: EA1141 paired breast MR and mammography DICOM series
cases.summary_claim: There is one patient and no retained diagnostic target or outcome table.
cases.grouping: One patient, linked slices; no independent predictive cohort
cases.limits: No clinical target, repeated echoes, registration truth or absolute calibration in retained subset.

cases.title: DANDI 001176 acetylcholine, axon imaging, pupil, and behavior NWB sessions
cases.summary_claim: Pupil persistence remains the development-selected one-second forecast and transfers to the reserved animal
cases.grouping: Animal, all sessions linked; two development animals and one reserved animal
cases.limits: Only three retained animals. Optical pixel calibration differs by animal/session; source ACh-M1/V1 recordings confound region and animal. No retinal physiology or real-time instrument claim.

cases.title: NVD recent CVE JSON 2.0 snapshot
cases.summary_claim: Age, publication-batch and CNA-availability hypotheses do not establish a transferable annotation-coverage mechanism in this snapshot.
cases.grouping: CVE records nested in complete assigning sources; duplicated JSON/gzip representations linked. Source-day batches dependent.
cases.limits: August23,2026 recent-feed snapshot only. Source status code is excluded; CVSS score formula and severity are not predicted. NIST policy deprioritizes duplicate scoring, so absence is not unsafe analysis failure.

cases.title: MLPerf Inference v6.0 summary results
cases.summary_claim: A compact calibrated utilization predictor transfers to the reserved system set, with substantial residual error and workload dependence.
cases.grouping: Submitter+platform system; all model/scenario aliases linked
cases.limits: Self-selected published MLPerf submissions; quality99.9 aliases removed and inferred results excluded. Different task families, software and latency constraints confound mechanism. No hardware causal efficiency ranking.

cases.title: NIST 200 mm hafnia-on-silicon wafer metrology collection
cases.summary_claim: A calibrated finite-film interference surrogate transfers measured higher-angle XRR structure to the reserved deposition batch better than a smooth envelope.
cases.grouping: Complete deposition batch is the split unit; wafer is the primary aggregation unit. All positions on a wafer stay together. Three deposition batches develop; fourth confirms.
cases.limits: Twelve200mmwafers with65ALDcycles from one process; three confirmation wafers share one deposition run.; Intensity-envelope and fringe parameters are effective metrology surrogates; density/thickness/roughness are not independently identified or verified by the author-fitted SE outputs.; The fixed angle range lies above critical-angle effects; calibrated counts are not absolute reflectivity.

cases.title: Census HTOPS Household Pulse March and May 2026 public-use files
cases.summary_claim: Declared household resources and reported income loss help describe food-insufficiency responses relative to prevalence-only prediction.
cases.grouping: Household/respondent nested in Census region and wave; no linked March/May SCRAMIDs in released files. Four geographic aggregates are not independent populations.
cases.limits: Responding complete-case households; region-balanced HWEIGHT risk, not a national prevalence estimate. Bracket midpoints including175k open upper bracket are declared proxies; source topcodes preserved; missing/negative codes and nonpositive weights excluded, no imputation.

cases.title: Federal Reserve 2025 SHED public-use microdata
cases.summary_claim: Piecewise resource and age/work associations yield a compact regional-transfer predictor of the reported inability-to-pay response.
cases.grouping: Respondents nested in whole states; source respondents may share unreported household/environmental dependencies. States not independent populations.
cases.limits: Positive-weight complete cases, state-balanced within-state survey-weighted predictive risk; not national prevalence or causal financial access. Income proxy upper bracket175k is a modeling convention. D1A0 reflects no paid work, not unemployment or a job-loss shock.

cases.title: BLS CPI and CES selected bulk time-series files
cases.summary_claim: Lagged partial adjustment provides an interpretable predictor better than persistence, with limited cross-period superiority.
cases.grouping: Whole calendar quarter; forward chronological development folds and2023-onward confirmation. One national economic system, overlapping lag windows and persistent macro shocks; quarters are not independent economies.
cases.limits: 1990–2026 US selected national seasonally adjusted series. Revised historical values and seasonal factors can incorporate later information. No causal Phillips-curve, policy intervention, operational financial-return or structural-inflation law claim.

cases.title: USGS ComCat July 2026 global M2.5+ earthquakes
cases.summary_claim: Reporting-regime and geometry covariates provide a compact predictor of author-supplied positive depth uncertainty in this source snapshot.
cases.grouping: Transitive clusters within100km great-circle chord and7days; complete cluster hashfolds. Distant events may still share network/systematic velocity model errors.
cases.limits: One July2026 catalog snapshot. Positive uncertainty reports only; mixed network estimation conventions, no universal standard-error confidence interpretation. Counts/geometry are outputs of location processing and causality is not identified.

cases.title: NOAA Storm Events 2025 details, fatalities, and locations
cases.summary_claim: Recorded pathgeometry carries descriptive information about broad reported property losses.
cases.grouping: NOAA EPISODE_ID outbreak groups; nearby episodes may still be correlated or linked across offices. Not individual property samples.
cases.limits: 2025 tornado segments with nonmissing explicit damage. Broad estimates including reported0, not insured claim totals. Maximum width times length is bounding footprint proxy, not actual damaged area. Exposure/building stock and wind speed unavailable; no prospective loss or causal damage law.

cases.title: NHTSA complaints, recalls, investigations, and manufacturer communications
cases.summary_claim: A compact two-timescale reporting-history blend improves mean reserved-month count error over the frozen matched controls.
cases.grouping: Whole target months; same known vehicle cohorts repeat, lag windows overlap. Three held months are not independent fleets or defect experiments.
cases.limits: Administrative complaint workload among known productVmake/model labels, not vehicle failures or safety risk. No fleet-at-risk denominator, reporting propensity or causal recall effect; dedupODINO/vehicle across components, snapshot relabeling remains.

cases.title: NOAA Coral Reef Watch global 5 km sea-surface temperature anomaly
cases.summary_claim: A small calibrated spatial stencil reconstructs fixed withheld water pixels more accurately than unweighted local averaging on this daily map.
cases.grouping: Complete20degree geographic tile for scoring; all tiles belong to one dependent global map, not independent temporal replicates.
cases.limits: Fixed complete-water neighborhoods exclude coasts, ice and missing neighborhoods.; No climate evolution, causal ocean mechanism or coral bleaching hazard is identified. This is not the NOAA coral bleaching heat-stress product.

cases.summary_claim: An explicitly calibrated six-coefficient spectral compression predicts reserved edge ordinates more accurately than either supplied reference or nominal-time two-phase mixing.

cases.limits: Nominalprogress is normalizedreportedsegmenttime, not measuredstateofcharge or an identifiedphasefraction.; Author3×binned spectra are excluded as duplicateobservations; onlyunbinnedcolumns are targets.; Onecell/onecycle; cross-blockcalibration successdoesnotestablishnewbatterychemistry orindustrialcycletransfer.

cases.title: Inverse parametric microwave scattering
cases.summary_claim: A small calibrated response model extrapolates off-diagonal USB magnitudes to the reserved higher pump settings better than holding the last calibration value.
cases.grouping: Completepumpstrengthmatrix; all156offdiagonaldirectedpairslinked. Oneinstrument/day; strengthlevels are not independent devices.
cases.limits: Magnitude in native fsu is not a calibrated dimensionless scattering coefficient; no passivity, quantumfidelity or reciprocity claim is inferred.; Only the purefrequencyconversion13mode experiment is targeted.31modeparametricgain andnumericalinverseproblemproducts remain context,notduplicateindependentobservations.; Finaltenhigherstrengthsettings test within-sweepextrapolation; no hardwaretransfer.

cases.title: Quantum circuit compilation benchmark experiments
cases.summary_claim: A positive Staq startup floor plus shared pilot-time scaling improves reserved-family runtime prediction over matched frozen controls.
cases.grouping: Circuit family after stripping numeric size suffixes; compiler observations on each family stay linked. One local CPU family; no independent hardware transfer.
cases.limits: Only device-transpilation successful matched tasks forTket/BQSKIT/Staq; no service remote latency. Missing/failed/timeouts excluded from conditional-success runtime target and retained in source audit; cannot infer success probability or realized routing speedup. Author timing environment differs in frequency/run state despite same CPU model.

cases.title: Smartphone PPG with ECG reference and acquisition disturbances
cases.summary_claim: Quality-dependent Fourier shrinkage has modest held-person benefit over a population median, while most improvement over raw estimates comes from the prior
cases.grouping: Person; every recording from one person linked
cases.limits: 50 participants in one smartphone protocol;10 held people. ECG-derived rate is an independent sensor reference, but no clinical agreement threshold or cardiovascular diagnosis is established.

cases.title: Ungulate vocalizations and production context
cases.summary_claim: A compact species/duration/digital-amplitude equation transfers source context-label prediction to held animals
cases.grouping: Animal within species; all calls and typo-linked names grouped
cases.limits: Seven ungulate species, source behavioral contexts and recording studies. Labels are experimental context-based valence annotations, not independently verified subjective emotion; held animals do not remove study/recording confounding.

cases.title: Dwarf tomato stress imaging and phenotypic measurements
cases.summary_claim: A compact pigment-quenching-recovery relation predicts source QY_max on held plants with lower mean error than registered comparators
cases.grouping: Plant; repeated sampling remains linked
cases.limits: Two dwarf cultivars under this controlled stress protocol. Source-extracted contemporaneous fluorescence/RGB traits; no independently measured hydration or new photosynthetic law.

cases.title: Adult skills, workplace use and earnings in USA and Japan
cases.summary_claim: A standard education and coarse experience-proxy association predicts upper within-country earnings ranks better than countryprevalence and comparably to flexible controls.
cases.grouping: Respondents nested in country and deterministic ten hashblocks; not10 independent samples from plausible values. Repeated respondent information stays linked. Survey clustering not publicly fully reconstructible.
cases.limits: Only valid reported earnings deciles, ages25–65 and complete education. Final weights within equal country×respondent blocks; not a pooled national population estimand. Potential experience age-schooling-6 is proxy, not measured tenure. No skill-wage causal claim; income reporting/topcoding and nonresponse remain.

cases.title: New York City green-taxi trips in 2025
cases.summary_claim: A short/long-distance and cyclic-clock equation improves completed-trip duration prediction in a reserved quarter against the frozen matched controls.
cases.grouping: Whole pickup calendar days; serial weather/traffic/vendor dependence persists. Forward month blocks, not random trips.
cases.limits: Green-taxi2025 declared routine records, duration0–24h and distance0–1000km; known officialzones and source-month-consistent timestamps. Provider-reported records may contain errors; no congestion intervention, routing policy or achieved operational benefit.

cases.title: National Age-Friendly Banking Survey
cases.summary_claim: The proposed contextual digital-substitution predictor fails to improve reserved-region branch-use risk over the frozen controls.
cases.grouping: Respondents nested in four Census regions. Only one held region: within-survey regional transfer, no population-level precision.
cases.limits: Complete-case banked adult survey with positive WEIGHT_FINAL; WEIGHT_ALT is not used. Region-balanced survey-weighted risk is not national prevalence. DK/refused/skipped are exclusions, not non-use. Geographic author-derived indicators are not measured travel distance.

cases.title: Fermi GBM GRB250206A spectra and responses
cases.summary_claim: An intensity-dependent count-space response improves the contemporaneous count-space reconstruction across reserved detectors under the fixed-bin and pretrigger-calibration contract.
cases.grouping: Detector within one GRB; detectors share one incident event
cases.limits: SingleGRB250206827, observed detector counts not deconvolved photon flux. NaI channel4 spans slightly different energy ranges by detector. No universal burst hardness law or independent event replication.

cases.title: MMS1 magnetic field and plasma moments on 2025-06-01
cases.summary_claim: A calibrated two-ratio closure improves local electron-temperature reconstruction within the retained two-hour interval.
cases.grouping: Contiguous20-minute blocks in one MMS1 passage, not independent spacecraft or experiments
cases.limits: One2-hour MMS1 interval. All ion moments have qualityflag66 (saturation plus highMach); ion targets excluded before any fit. Electron flags0 and FGMflags0 retained. Moment errors and unmeasured heat flux/geometry limit CGL interpretation.

cases.title: DLR lithium-graphite cell GITT and quasi-open-circuit measurements
cases.summary_claim: A parameter-free finite-pulse diffusion shape provides useful calibrated late-relaxation forecasts within this half-cell campaign.
cases.grouping: Complete rest block linked to preceding current pulse; all blocks belong to one half-cell, so block summaries are not independent-cell confidence.
cases.limits: One Li-graphite half-cell and one GITT campaign; no population transfer or diffusion-coefficient identification.; POCV file is preserved but not used because it has a different protocol.

cases.title: USGS debris-flow gate-release laser measurements
cases.summary_claim: A locally oscillatory height model improves the 200 ms forecast over native persistence on a new complete release.
cases.grouping: Complete gate-release run/date; firstfour columns develop, final11April2024 column confirms. Five controlled events are not a field-hazard population.
cases.limits: This is a within-station nowcast, not advance warning upstream or a forecast before sensor detection.; The archived swath-processing example trims around a future peak; that operation is excluded. Cross-instrument alignment is not inferred.; Four debris flows and one water-only flood are described by the source, but filecolumns do not provide a reliable event-type map; no material-specific claim is made.

cases.title: Hydrogen permeation test on MS AHSS grade 1300
cases.summary_claim: A condition-aware activated-breakthrough surrogate predicts the reserved late portions of these two traces more accurately than the matched controls.
cases.grouping: Two chronological traces with no independent specimen identifiers; nonoverlapping temporal blocks are scoring units, not independent specimens. All trace linkage is explicit.
cases.limits: The two traces do not establish independent-specimen transfer. Temperature is293K; nominal sheet thickness1.2mm.; Native time zero is used as reported; true boundary concentration and its step timing are not independently measured.; An effective relaxation scale must not be relabeled a unique lattice diffusivity because trapping, boundary kinetics and baseline uncertainty can be confounded.

cases.title: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics applied to the levitation of acoustically large objects
cases.summary_claim: The constrained delay-history control supplies a reproducible5ms native-voltage predictor across held acquisition traces.
cases.grouping: Complete acquisitiontrace, with raw/denoised pair linked; sixmetadata-hashselectedtracesconfirm. Alltraces shareone levitator/object setup.
cases.limits: Primarysource conversion lists125/4 while suppliedMATLABcode uses500/4; nativevoltage is retained to avoid asserting an unsupportedvelocityscale.; Stored1/2kHz sample grids differs from article4kHz acquisition; the adapter preserves storedtiming.; The filename-to-excitation-amplitude mapping is not supplied. Cross-traceprediction is not proof of independentobject or arbitraryexcitationtransfer.; Polynomial coefficients in voltage-delay space are not mechanical force coefficients.

cases.title: Imaging Localized Slip-induced Frictional Heating during Laboratory Earthquakes Using Magnetic Microscopy
cases.summary_claim: A fixed two-scale curvature stencil reconstructs measured Bz map pixels more accurately than the matched affine control on the reserved specimen.
cases.grouping: Two specimens: CSH/119DOA development and CSL/129DOA confirmation. Spatial blocks balance errors but are not independent specimens; development folds are entire200row strips.
cases.limits: Native README identifies Bz maps but does not establish numerical SI conversion; scores deliberately remain source-native units.; Temperature profiles, MCMC inversion outputs and maximum-temperature samples are author-derived and excluded as independent targets.; A two-dimensional smooth stencil is not a consequence of the three-dimensional magnetostatic Laplace equation without information about vertical derivatives.

cases.title: Substrate Stiffness and Shear Stress Orchestrate Endothelial Inflammation and Remodelling via Mechanosensitive Pathways
cases.summary_claim: A donor-calibrated shared shear response generalizes better than calibration alone
cases.grouping: Donor; four donors, three development and one confirmation
cases.limits: Condition response in four cultured endothelial donors; one held donor cannot establish population generalization. One measured LSS/30kPa VCAM1 calibration per donor is required.

cases.title: ONE-STEP tagging: a versatile method for rapid site-specific integration by simultaneous reagent delivery
cases.summary_claim: Constant positive joint association transfers better than marginal independence in the reserved replicate block, but worse than the matched flexible comparator
cases.grouping: Named experimental replicate block A/B/C; three doses within each
cases.limits: One hiPSC cell line, one multiplex tagging design, three replicate blocks; same-well marginal readouts are permitted. This tests distributional dependence, not pre-experiment editing yield or a new gene-editing mechanism.

cases.title: Wearable device measurements during stress and exercise
cases.summary_claim: Causal EDA persistence transfers to held participants better than registered drift/flexible controls
cases.grouping: Participant; all aerobic segments of a person linked
cases.limits: One aerobic study with two protocol versions; no mental-stress or clinical diagnosis. Source device clocks are not necessarily calendar measurement dates, and manufacturer EDA calibration remains author-provided.

cases.title: Methods to Verify and Account for the Carbon and Soil Health Benefits of Agroforestry - Annex to Deliverable 3.5 ( DigitAF EU Project) : Soil Dataset (Machine readable).
cases.summary_claim: An uncalibrated two-phase carbon-density mixture improves transfer to unseen countries over simple controls.
cases.grouping: Entire country/site portfolio, with all transects, fields and depths linked. Eight countries are convenience samples, not a random population sample.
cases.limits: Texture is unavailable in six countries and excluded rather than imputed. C stocks are excluded because they use bulk density algebraically.; Observational associations do not identify an agroforestry treatment effect. Protocol adaptations and country effects may limit transfer.

cases.title: Experimental dataset on Microstructured cellulose acetate biointerfaces regulate mesenchymal stem cell response and promote osteogenic commitment
cases.summary_claim: A localized-adhesion correction improves calibrated late-retraction force prediction across reserved locations on the three samples.
cases.grouping: Complete approach/retraction curve is held together; one hashselectedcurveper surface type confirms. Curves are locations on three samples, not independentmanufacturingbatches.
cases.limits: Piezo position is not true indentation; effective contact models are predictive surrogates, not certified elasticmoduli.; No stem-cell response measurements are present in this retained package; no osteogenesis conclusion follows.; Ramp sampling frequency is not resolved; progress is dimensionless and no relaxation time in seconds is inferred.

cases.title: Release for manuscript submission of Nasioulas et al. 2025
cases.summary_claim: A compact historical-propensity and persistence model is competitive with the full matched flexible predictor on held participants
cases.grouping: Participant; full blocks and all trials linked
cases.limits: Seven source experiments, participant transfer within the same laboratory task designs; no financial-advice, causal psychology identification or real-world impact claim.

cases.title: Individual locomotor bias drives counterclockwise motion in pedestrian crowds
cases.summary_claim: The proposed aggregate-memory and heterogeneity equation improves reserved-condition two-second rotation prediction over all matched controls.
cases.grouping: Whole country/experiment-condition group with all repetitions; participants may recur across conditions and identifiers do not resolve all dependence. One teen condition keptdevelopment, no heldteen generalization.
cases.limits: Within-source group-rotation temporal dynamics after observed prefix. Centroid-based XY-derived order differs from authors supplied Pol; no arithmetic identity predicted at same time. Source published conditionmeans already known; confirmation not unseen-world evidence. No novel biological handedness or safety intervention law.

cases.title: Flow cytometry FCS files: Cell surface VVL staining of MFSD5, SLC30A8 and SLC30A8-D110N-D224N OE cells
cases.summary_claim: Line-specific paired-control scaling transfers induced native AF488 quantiles to a held technical block
cases.grouping: Matched technical replicate block across cell lines; three blocks on one plate
cases.limits: One plate and three technical replicate blocks. Does not establish biological-replicate transfer, transporter causality or glycan concentration. The channel/caption inconsistency prevents unqualified dye-specific biological claims.

cases.title: Data of the crowd movement experiment.
cases.summary_claim: Refitting a free-area exponential law on the development cohorts improves transfer to the reserved multidirectional conditions over the published source law and matched flexible control.
cases.grouping: Complete source figure cohorts; F3D and F3E are linked as the multidirectional-study family and reserved together. Person/run identifiers are missing, so independence within or between figure cohorts is not established.
cases.limits: F3A simulation is excluded; source-processed plotting tables are not raw trajectories.; Panel-to-study mapping follows the article ordered empirical-condition list and cited original studies: F3B unidirectional/Zhang2011; F3C counterflow/Zhang2012; F3D/F3E cross/four-directional/Cao2017. Exact original run accession IDs are not retained.; Only within-source condition transfer is assessed. No independent population validation, causal pedestrian mechanism or safe capacity limit is claimed.; Flow and gait algebraic identities are excluded as predictive targets and confirmations.

cases.title: Dataset of Kantorovich-Rubinstein-Wasserstein Polytopes of Metric Spaces on up to 6 Points
cases.summary_claim: The exact dual-potential construction reproduces the native finite corpus and supplies executable checks of proposed facet-count rules.
cases.grouping: Source facet-incidence combinatorial type modulo coordinate permutation; all metric representatives of that type stay together
cases.limits: Five-point finite source catalog; published theory already characterizes generic types and arrangement. Exact computational reproduction is not a new theorem or independent experimental truth. Exact metric duplicate representations are deduplicated; generic/strict representatives with same coordinate-relabeled facet incidence remain in one group. Incidence-derived family labels are not predictors. Native POINTS and supplied metric vectors can differ by uniform scale; verify exact proportional distance multiset, which preserves facets.

cases.title: Mouse hippocampal calcium imaging during a context fear memory retrieval task
cases.summary_claim: A compact asymmetric local-recovery equation predicts future released population-trace means across held animals better than registered controls in mean error
cases.grouping: Animal suffix across all days,contexts and sessions
cases.limits: Retained author-processed calcium traces only; amplitude normalization/calcium-event interpretation is not documented in the archive. No spikes,absolute calcium concentration or real-time physiology claim. Twenty-eight source animals; held animals stay within the same study.
